notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello! I hope everyone is enjoying their adventure in Tongs Delta!
I got some feedback and noticed some bugs, so I just published a patch.
Changes:
- Fixed automove stopping too easily on controller
- Fixed "I gathered ther fruit" typo
- Fixed most signposts being blank
- Fixed using sleeping bag on controller blocking the camera
- Added Camera Speed setting
- Added Mounting/Unmounting input to Controls menu

Thank you everybody for playing the game, and if you have any feedback or encountered bugs, please let me know!
Best place for that is our Discord: https://discord.gg/qWmPRKqTfk
Take care,
Simon

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44150114/45aae5f6389584eea4f11e05785e3746bca1bd5a.gif
Hello Traveler!
I have a very cool announcement:
The game's demo has been updated!

If you haven't played already (why?!) Little Odyssey has a free demo on Steam, right on the store page. But I have noticed it's a bit dated and does not reflect current game quality. So I updated it! Right now you can go and see if Little Odyssey is for you! 
And if it is, a reminder: Little Odyssey is launching on 17th of May, so wishlist now!

I also added Linux support, but this is still an EXPERIMENTAL feature, so let me know if it works fine for you!

And if you want to see even better what changed, take a look:
[previewyoutube=ig0uuampMV8;full][/previewyoutube]

Take care,
Simon
